baseline_note: Introductory concepts, official tutorial/documentation source inspection and hand-calculated illustrative numbers only. PyTorch and Hugging Face are independent document baselines, not a tested dependency combination or model benchmark. PyTorch code was not executed. The Azure taxonomy document is a historical fixed source (ms.date 2024-01-19) preceding migration; only stable definitions are adopted, paired with current first-party teaching sources. Web page last_updated values are the displayed dates, not fixed snapshots; no web-page mirror is stored. No device, deployed product, model weights, or training/inference runtime was verified.
